title: Dimensions of permanental varieties in arbitrary size
summary: Let $I_h(a,b)$ be the ideal generated by the $h\times h$ permanents of a generic $a\times b$ matrix over a field of characteristic different from two. We prove that $\dim K[X]/I_h(a,b)=\max(a,b)(h-1)$ whenever $1\le h\le\min(a,b)$ and $h<\max(a,b)$. Consequently, the critical locus of the permanent of order $n$ has codimension $2n$ for every $n\ge 2$. We also prove that the maximal permanents of a generic $k\times(k+1)$ matrix generate a geometrically reduced complete intersection.
